traps: devcontainer.json is JSON with Comments: line comments and a trailing comma; a strict JSON parser fails on it

the image is not in devcontainer.json: dockerComposeFile and service point to .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml, whose app image typescript-node:1-20-bookworm carries Node 20 (the 1 is the image version, bookworm the Debian release)
Python 3.12 comes from a dev container feature, not from any manifest: no Python code in the repository
docker-in-docker:2 is a feature version, not a Docker version; it installs the latest Docker by default
the dev container is for development only: no Dockerfile for production, and the database exists only as the db service of the dev compose file
postCreateCommand npm ci needs a package-lock.json that is not in the fixture
every dev container fact lives under .devcontainer/: a reader whose perimeter skips dot folders never sees them
